newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU monitoring Dutch mad cow case.
newsitem.headline: EU monitoring Dutch mad cow case.

text.p: The European Union is monitoring an outbreak of mad cow disease in the Netherlands, a Commission official said on Monday.
The cow found to have Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy (BSE) on a dairy farm in eastern Netherlands did not come from Britain, a Dutch government official said.
"The issue may be raised at the next meeting of the EU standing veterinary committee either by the Dutch government or by the Commission," the official said.
The cow found to have the disease came from a dairy farm which does not trade in animals. It had an American father and a Dutch mother, another EU member state official said.

"At the moment there appears to be no explanation for this outbreak. Veterinary experts are looking at several possibilities, one of which could be that it was a spontaneous outbreak," the official said.
Three calves of the infected cow have been traced. The only surviving calf has now been slaughtered, the Dutch government said at the weekend. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
